clientFunction.name: display_game_widget
clientFunction.description: Invoke a client-side function to render a Handlebars template in the chat widget containing a list of games for the user to select from.

games.description: Required. A list of games to display in the carousel.

subtitle.description: Required. A short, engaging description or tagline of the game.

title.description: Required. The name of the game.

uri.description: Required. The direct link (URL) to play the game.

context.description: Required. The context object containing the data to render the template.

template_id.description: Required. The ID of the template to render. ALWAYS set this to "game_carousel".
